description: This file defines the SeoControlServlet class, a specialized servlet that extends ControlServlet to handle SEO-related request processing within a Java web application. It manages initialization parameters, route handling for requests, and integration with Jasper and Catalina servlets for rendering.

classes.name: SeoControlServlet
classes.description: A servlet that extends ControlServlet to manage SEO-related request processing and route handling, with configurable default pages and integration with JSP and default servlets for rendering responses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, setting default page and control servlet parameters, and invoking SEO configuration utility.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, encoding the request URI, checking request attributes, and delegating to JSP or default servlets if necessary.

methods.name: getDefaultPage
methods.description: Accessor for the default page URL.

methods.name: setDefaultPage
methods.description: Setter for the default page URL.

methods.name: getControlServlet
methods.description: Accessor for the control servlet name.

methods.name: setControlServlet
methods.description: Setter for the control servlet name.
